text:
kai (People Ops): Heads-up: were trialing a manager dry-run week before the actual signoff. The goal is to catch form routing & redaction issues. Please RSVP if you want a mock panel.
ravi (Eng Manager): Nice. How long are dry-run sessions?
kai (People Ops): 45m including 10m for QA. We'll simulate one calibration packet and walk through post-panel updates.
sasha (Design): Can designers join to confirm cross-functional evidence flows? We have special cases with user research.
kai (People Ops): Yes please. Cross-func reps encouraged. Add "dry-run: cross-func" to the calendar title so we can slot you.
marta (Legal): Quick legal check: are we allowing raw Slack quotes in packets? Need to ensure no PII gets carried over.
kai (People Ops): Raw quotes allowed only if redacted. Our recommended flow: paste thread into a doc, replace user handles with initials, remove email addresses. We'll include a one-click redaction script in the kit.
sam (IC): Will mock packets be persisted? I prefer they don't become part of the audit trail.
kai (People Ops): Dry-run packets are ephemeral and stored in a sandbox folder. They are NOT copied to the official audit exports. We'll tag them with "dry-run" in the filename.
ravi (Eng Manager): How do we test the form routing to alternate reviewers? I want to make sure proxies work when someone's OOO.
forms-bot: To test proxy routing run: 
```
POST /internal/reviews/proxy-test 
{"manager":"ravi@redwood.com","proxy":"alex@redwood.com"}
```
kai (People Ops): Good call. We'll include that curl in the dry-run agenda. Also testing will surface any calendar invite perms issues.
sasha (Design): Any guidance for evidence that references customer PII (e.g., support tickets)?
marta (Legal): Redact customer PII. Use ticket IDs only and include product-safe summary. If you need Legal to sanitize, ping us and we'll provide a redaction pass.
kai (People Ops): One more thing: we're piloting a "buddy review" where two managers co-review one packet before calibration to surface obvious rating discrepancies early. Volunteers?
ravi (Eng Manager): I'll volunteer for one buddy review. Sounds useful.
sam (IC): Is buddy review shared with the IC?
kai (People Ops): No — it's internal between managers and People Ops. The manager still owns the manager conversation with the IC.
sasha (Design): Can we get the dry-run checklist and the redaction script before Friday?
kai (People Ops): Yes. I'll post the checklist + script in the drive by EOD and DM the calendar invite. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
